title: THE PIXEL ARMOUR AND GOLD
why: His picks a20 A (elite ring), a21 B (the golden enemy is solid gold with a shine), a22 (the chase tell) from the art survey and SPEC 9.7 (the armour tier reads as a silhouette), plus his 10-20 orders for the pixel art pass. Job 86g, ship 3: armour tiers, the golden pillager bot, the elite ring and the tell stay pixel instead of falling back to the vector body.
now: Armoured pillagers wear pixel plates (a chest plate, then pauldrons, then a collar and a helmet), the golden pillager bot is solid gold with a pixel shine, the elite ring is a pixel ring, and the chase tell flares the eyes.
